ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The buses and taxis in a certain city have basically achieved full electric coverage, which not only saves energy but also protects the environment. The principle of motor drive can be qualitatively simplified into the circuit shown in the figure. On a horizontal ground, there is a magnetic field of $B=5 T$ perpendicular to the plane and pointing inward. A conductor rod $ab$ with a resistance of $1 \Omega$ is placed vertically on a conductor frame with a width of $0.2\mathrm{m}$. The power source $E$ is composed of many lithium batteries connected in series, each with a working voltage of $4 V$, and the internal resistance of the power source and the resistance of the conductor frame are negligible. When the power source is connected, the conductor rod $ab$ can move at a constant speed in a straight line. If the conductor rod $ab$ needs to overcome a resistance of $400 N$ to move at a constant speed.

1. Will the conductor rod $ab$ move to the left or to the right at a constant velocity?
2. How many lithium batteries need to be connected in series to match the power supply $E$?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a power supply E, connected between the upper and lower two horizontal conductor frames; in the frame there is a vertical conducting rod ab, the upper end is labeled a, and the lower end is labeled b; the width of the conductor frame is 0.2 m. The magnetic field region in the figure is indicated by multiple “×” symbols, indicating that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface inward. From the polarity of the power supply symbol in the figure, when the current passes through the conducting rod, its direction is from a to b, that is, downward along the conducting rod. Reasoning: The current in the conducting rod is downward, and the direction of the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface inward. According to the left-hand rule or the judgment of the direction of the Ampere force, the direction of the magnetic field force on the conducting rod is horizontally to the right, so the direction of uniform motion of the conducting rod is to the right. During uniform motion, the magnetic field force and the resistance are balanced, so F = BIL. Substituting F=400 N, B=5 T, L=0.2 m, gives I = F/(BL) = 400/(5×0.2) = 400 A. The resistance of the conducting rod is 1 Ω, and other resistances are ignored, so the electromotive force of the power supply E = IR = 400×1 = 400 V. The voltage of each lithium battery is 4 V, and the number of cells connected in series n = 400/4 = 100.
